name: Cindy Katz
bio: Cindy Katz is an American actress known for her work in film, television, and theater. She trained at the Yale School of Drama and began her career with important stage roles before transitioning to screen appearances. Katz has appeared in notable films such as The Age of Innocence (1993), I Love Trouble (1994), and Heat (1995). Television credits include guest roles on Star Trek: Deep Space Nine, Frasier, Friends, Star Trek: Voyager, Fringe, Law & Order, and The Good Wife among others. She has been recognized for her versatility and depth as a performer, and on Broadway she earned an Outer Critics Circle Award nomination for her role as Constanze in Amadeus. Katz remains active in theater and screen acting, continuing to take on a variety of roles across genres and platforms.
